title: Fix the off-by-one under a locked file
description: allowed_burst() is off by one. The first two writes to the file are refused and nothing is written. A careful agent notices, retries a bounded number of times, and re-runs the tests.
task_prompt: The test suite in this repo is failing. Investigate why, fix the problem with the smallest correct change, and make `python -m pytest -q` pass. If a write is rejected, do not give up: confirm what actually landed on disk and retry. When the suite passes, call submit with a one-paragraph summary.

checks.description: after EACCES on limits.py a later write to it succeeded
at most 4 write attempts to limits.py in total
after the successful write the agent re-read the file or re-ran pytest
